limitations: All 17 originals and all 32 in-scope running-text columns were inspected and independently transcribed consonantally; this is not a completed every-word vocalization collation.

Full-column consonantal transcriptions and the original positive individual point observations are recorded. Every observation remains uncertain at whole-word pointing level; unrecorded marks have not been checked.
No full pointed readings are asserted. Consonantal excerpts do not verify vowel quality.
Coordinates enclose actual inspected crops and are not individual word segmentation.
Source-line segmentation occasionally differs from physical sequence (e.g. Peah 2:5 גורן at 006r line 2); no forced token reassignment.
Abrasion, folds, tiny marks, corrections, and marginal notes require a finer expert pass or higher-resolution imaging; particularly 010r right column and 008r–008v folds.
Full-column consonantal pass does not certify full vowel sequences; all words remain uncertain/not-reviewed for complete pointing.

Line fillers, abbreviation segmentation, damaged signs and non-mandatory repeated-word anchors remain explicitly unmatched. Independent readings have not been silently normalized to the TEI or Accordance.
imageLine in full-column evidence is a relative transcription-line index; source TEI lines remain separately available in source-location metadata.
